newsitem.title: CHINA: Huge China nickel plant to double production.
newsitem.headline: Huge China nickel plant to double production.

text.p: A major nickel production base in northwestern China's Gansu province has completed work to double its annual output, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

The 2.3 billion yuan ($277 million) second phase of the Jinchuan mine and production complex would allow it to double nickel production, which totalled 33,000 tonnes in 1995, the agency said. It gave no details of expected 1996 output.
The Jinchuan plant accounted for 88 percent of China's total nickel output, while its platinum production accounted for 90 percent of the national total, Xinhua said.
In 1995 the base produced 300 tonnes of cobalt, 20,000 tonnes of copper, 500 kg of rare metals and 400,000 tons of sulphuric acid, it said.
It gave no details of platinum production.
The plant exported to Japan, France, Iran and the United States, Xinhua said. It did not elaborate.
